meta.title: Poker Home
meta.description: Scorekeeping and settle-up for home poker nights. No real money moves through the app.

landing.title: The scorebook for your poker night
landing.subtitle: Record buy-ins and cash-outs, settle up in the fewest transfers, and keep a history nobody can quietly edit.
landing.f1Body: Once the host closes a game, nobody can change it. Not even us.
landing.f2Body: Who pays whom, with open debts carried forward and netted.
landing.f3Body: Persian, English, Arabic, French, Italian, Russian and Spanish.
landing.disclaimer: Poker Home keeps score only. It never holds or moves money.

sidepot.title: All-in and side pot calculator
sidepot.intro: Enter how much each player put in during the hand and whether they folded. You get the main pot, every side pot and who can win each.
sidepot.chooseWinners: Pick the winner(s) of each pot.
sidepot.invalid: Enter whole, non-negative amounts, and at least one player who did not fold.

showdown.title: Who wins?
showdown.intro: Enter the board and each hand, like: As Kd 7h. The best hand and the reason are shown.
showdown.byTiebreak: Same category; decided by card {n} of the best five.
showdown.tie: Identical best five cards: the pot is split.
showdown.invalid: Check the cards: use rank (2–9, T, J, Q, K, A) and suit (s, h, d, c), with no duplicates.

import.title: Import an old spreadsheet
import.intro: Upload an .xlsx or .csv file with one row per player per game. Needed columns: date, player, and either buy-in and cash-out, or buy-in and net. A game number column is optional; without it, rows with the same date form one game.
import.noColumns: Could not find the date, player and amount columns. Check the header row.
